skills.name: New Year's Resolution
skills.description: Writes a New Year's resolution to encourage surrounding allies. Good effects on allies.  *Hit Rate +30%  (7 sec) *Skill Hit Rate +30% (7 sec) *HP x 40% Area Recovery (per sec) (7 sec)

skills.name: Special Strokes
skills.description: Swings around his brush broadly to attack. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy buffs   *ATK x 2500% Area Damage  *Enemy ATK -50% (7 sec) - Only attacks Flyer units

abilities.name: Air Ambush
abilities.description: Attacks Flyer units. Buff is activated when attacking Flyer units. (ATK/Hit Rate/Skill Hit Rate)

abilities.name: Ally Clone
abilities.description: Has a set chance of summoning 1 allied team Ranger when Rangers deploy.　  - Flyer and Air Ambush Rangers are not eligible to be summoned in this way.  - The Abilities of allied Rangers summoned by this Ability won't activate. - Summoned Rangers won't consume any Mineral and will have no effects on redeploy times.
